newsitem.title: USA: Enova says to buy back up to 3 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Enova says to buy back up to 3 mln shrs.

text.p: Enova Corp said on Tuesday that its board of directors has authorized the company to purchase up to 3 million shares of its outstanding common stock.
Under the board authorization, purchases may be made periodically either in the open market or through private transactions, the company said.
As of December 31, 1996, there were approximately 116.6 million shares of Enova common stock outstanding, the company said.

Enova anticipates that this repurchase will not affect its ability to engage in transactions in the future that are to be accounted for as a pooling of interests, including the pending merger with Pacific Enterprises, the company said.
